title: Anti-Ragging Cell | KPGU
content: ng a clear message that no act of ragging shall be tolerated and any act of ragging shall not go unnoticed and unpunished. SUPPORT & REPORTING Regulations UGC Regulation 2009 Anti-Ragging Regulations UGC Regulation on Curbing the Menace of Ragging in Higher Educational Institutions, 2009 completely forbids ragging of any kind in an institute of higher education.
